plan.question: Across the complete declared q1 through q14 grid, how do isolated +q and -(q+1) products and their fixed -1/256 paired reference compare under WMMA and scalar execution?

estimands.primary: Retain complete exact WMMA/scalar diagnostics and C00 word for every q, role and execution order.
estimands.magnitude_curve: Report every tested q outcome separately by role and variant/order; any first mismatch refers only to this complete finite grid and does not imply monotonicity.
estimands.matched_components: Retain each pair beside its corresponding positive and negative standalone controls; do not assume additivity of observed errors.

plan.trace_selection: The q01-pair, q12-pair and q14-pair K2 conditions were selected before execution; each paired trace is WMMA-first.
plan.acceptance: Retain complete numerical failure with the exact oracle unchanged. Structural, input-snapshot or guard corruption stops subsequent stages. No performance acceptance or predetermined scalar/WMMA outcome.
limitations: This finite magnitude grid does not establish a global threshold, monotonicity, a globally minimal counterexample or a unique arithmetic cause.
Standalone-product and paired-product outcomes are observations; equality, failure and decomposition of an error are not imposed.
Three input snapshots establish capture-boundary equality only, not transient values inside a kernel.
Source-level scalar operations are not a forced ISA implementation; unchanged kernel bodies do not establish unchanged binaries.
All six prior suites remain auxiliary observations. Three preselected pair traces do not profile all42 conditions. No accepted timings or speedup ratios.

All six auxiliary suites, unprofiled magnitude sweeps and the three preselected pair profiles remain separately identified; no full-grid profiler coverage.
